contract: Cancel the original child directly while its parent waits. The parent must catch cancellation of that original child and complete. Preserve parent/call/link/child/run and failure relationships, exact typed int64 input, caller reason and the complete child failure diagnostic. The published PHP SDK exposes ChildWorkflowFailed with failureType ChildRunCancelled and the original child resolution payload/message. Embedded execution catches WorkflowCancelledException with a parent-facing message naming the original child run and commits FailureHandled; assert these adapter representations before comparing common behavior. Duplicate cancellation preserves both histories and embedded physical child failure storage; fresh reads retain the original outcomes. Before-claim cancellation observes a pending child with zero child claims; timer cancellation observes a waiting child with one child claim. The original parent resumes once for its cancelled child. Propagation trees, parent-close policies, retries, hard-kill child-cancellation recovery and cross-language directions are separate gates.
